edited-payload.description: A letter of Lina's comment text changed in Notepad: the payload no longer hashes to "ph".

edited-line.description: The label of Rana's severity edit changed: the op fields no longer hash to its id.

removed-line.description: Rana's third op (adding Omar) was deleted from segment 1.

reordered.description: Omar's second and third ops swapped places in his segment.

truncated-tail.description: Omar's last op (his approval) was cut off; Rana's later op and the checkpoint reference it.

dropped-segment.description: Rana's first segment file is missing; segment 2 and the other chains reference its ops.

forked-chain.description: A copied folder kept writing Lina's chain: a second, validly signed op claims her seq 3.

bad-signature.description: Omar's first op carries a signature made with Lina's key.

payload-stripped.description: The payload of Omar's first comment was removed and no redaction op names it.

redacted-payload.description: Legitimate redaction: Rana (owner) redacts Omar's first comment with an op.redact op; the payload is gone, the chain still verifies (counts.redacted = 1).
